    The simple representation at a point of a piece #

    The simple representation S(x) (pointRep) is a brick (brick_pointRep). On a piece of the universal cover it respects the relations (respectsCover_pointRep): nonempty paths act by zero, and the composite of a nonempty path is never invertible (not_isIso_compD). It serves as one member of the Kronecker pair (S(x), V) of Bongartz's Lemma 4.
